title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.21 — Settling Undrawn Gallons Against a Refined Fuels Booking
content:
Where gallons stand undrawn on a pre-buy booking held on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts, the desk releases them and applies the money they come to against that booking. The gallons named come off the gallons still owed to the member out of the booking, the line carries the price they were released at, and the money worked out on them is applied against the booking. The member sees the gallons still owed fall by the gallons released, and the money applied shown on the next statement for the account.

The money applied against a booking on the gallons standing undrawn is worked out only after the account's contracted price of record stands at a price worked out from the bookings the account carries.

## Recording the release

The release is recorded with `settle_undrawn_contract_gallons_1dbcf678`, which the agent unlocks and then calls. The desk works the gallons, the price and the money out and passes them in already formed.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `energy_account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the refined fuels or propane account whose booking is being released, as returned by the energy account lookup |
| `gallons` | The gallons released out of the booking, in US gallons to 1 decimal place, passed as a decimal number and stored as given with no further rounding |
| `settlement_price_per_gallon` | The price the released gallons are settled at, in USD per gallon to 4 decimal places, passed as a decimal number and stored as given |
| `undrawn_settlement_usd` | The money applied against the booking, in USD to 2 decimal places, passed as a positive decimal number and rounded half to even to 2 decimal places on the way in |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference of the drawdown line written, the gallons released, the price they were settled at in USD per gallon to 4 decimal places and the money applied against the booking in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that sentence is what indicates the gallons are released and the money stands applied.

### Contract questions

**What does the member see change on the account?** The gallons still owed to them out of the booking fall by the gallons released, and the money applied shows on the next statement.

**Is more than one line written per call?** No. One call writes a single drawdown line onto the account.
